title: Welcome to the Study
subtitle: Here's what you'll do. Please read carefully before continuing.
consent_text: I understand this is a research study and agree to participate.
note: Shown once, after login, before the pre-survey (S1). Consent checkbox required on first visit; skipped if consent_given is already true.

ai_debrief.label: Pre-study survey
ai_debrief.detail: A few quick questions about your negotiation background and confidence.

ai_debrief.label: Read a short negotiation guide
ai_debrief.detail: A brief introduction to five key principles for effective negotiation.

ai_debrief.label: Negotiate (Round 1)
ai_debrief.detail: A text-based conversation with an AI counterpart in an assigned scenario.

ai_debrief.label: Quick check-in survey
ai_debrief.detail: A quick check-in about how you felt during the negotiation.

ai_debrief.label: AI debrief with Sage
ai_debrief.detail: An AI coach will guide you through key moments from your negotiation.

ai_debrief.label: Reflection survey
ai_debrief.detail: A few questions about how the debrief helped you.

ai_debrief.label: Negotiate (Round 2)
ai_debrief.detail: A second negotiation scenario to apply what you learned.

ai_debrief.label: Self-efficacy check
ai_debrief.detail: A few questions about how you felt during the second negotiation.

ai_debrief.label: Learning reflection
ai_debrief.detail: Questions about what you learned and how your approach changed.

ai_debrief.label: Your AI assessment
ai_debrief.detail: An AI assessment of your Round 1 negotiation is released here.

ai_debrief.label: Final experience survey
ai_debrief.detail: A few questions about your overall experience in this study.
